d: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards claim Tehran can strike American military bases in Europe, raising fresh questions about the range of its ballistic missiles. Satellite and missile-related claims involving Diego Garcia have also put Iran’s reported long-range capabilities under scrutiny. We examine the Khorramshahr missile, the connection between Iran’s space programme and long-range weapons, and whether Tehran could eventually develop an intercontinental ballistic missile.
